articles.title: Salesforce issues revenue target of over $63 billion for fiscal 2030, beating estimates
articles.description: Salesforce issued some updated longer-term financials at its annual Dreamforce conference.

articles.title: House passes sweeping Russia sanctions bill honoring Lindsey Graham, sends to Trump

articles.title: Jim Cramer warns that buying stocks now means 'fighting the Federal Reserve'

articles.title: Crypto Tax Bill Clears House Committee After Clarity Act Setback
articles.description: The bill would exempt qualifying crypto fees from gain-or-loss calculations and restrict tax-loss deductions on tokens sold and quickly repurchased.

articles.title: House votes to hold Leon Black in contempt of Congress over Epstein subpoenas defiance
